name: Heuristic Billboard Texture Generation
definition: A method to generate view-dependent textures for volumetric cells (billboards) by selecting texels from input images based on a heuristic comparing cell and pixel transparencies, avoiding blurring associated with simple projection.
summary: Heuristic Billboard Texture Generation creates view-dependent volumetric textures by selecting texels based on transparency metrics, avoiding the blurring of simple projection methods.
